policy_name: Small deterministic, evidence-grounded selector for three calibrated project archetypes

fact_semantics.false: explicitly negated in scoped structured fact
fact_semantics.unknown: not supplied or not evidenced; never coerced to false

descriptive_text_policy: Non-authoritative; ignored by every selection rule and omitted from decision content. Only structured facts, authority/evidence objects and versioned catalog records are evaluated.

source.mobile_applications.01.rationale: The source locator concerns Android/native mobile application architecture and is not evidence for an API-specific claim.

rules.name: Contradictory or malformed facts abstain
rules.predicate: Duplicate fact_id with incompatible state, malformed contract, or incompatible authority/evidence tuple
rules.effect: Return INCOMPLETE; enumerate conflict IDs; do not emit positive recommendations based on disputed facts.

rules.name: Calibrated category boundary
rules.predicate: A requested software_type_id is unknown or not in the calibrated list
rules.effect: Emit INCOMPLETE for that category branch; do not infer category-derived features or service components.

rules.name: Explicit feature exclusions dominate defaults
rules.predicate: A feature fact is explicitly false, or a category alone is the only basis for the feature
rules.effect: Emit INAPPLICABLE; exclude the feature and its architecture/service patterns.

rules.name: No authority, no high-impact side effect
rules.predicate: Write/destructive action is requested but scope authorization, accountable approver or action-specific approval is false/unknown
rules.effect: Emit INCOMPLETE; disallow execution/authorization; state a safe read-only or non-destructive interim and required authority evidence.

rules.name: Candidate-bound gates cannot pass on authored source
rules.predicate: Candidate identity, linked run record, candidate match, required approval or executed result is absent
rules.effect: Gate status stays INCOMPLETE; PASS is not an available output value.

rules.name: Standard edition and adoption boundary
rules.predicate: Requested edition differs from catalog-current edition or organization adoption is unknown
rules.effect: Emit INCOMPLETE/CONDITIONAL with exact catalog locator; do not assert normative applicability or compliance.

rules.name: Untrusted agent input requires boundary design
rules.predicate: AI-agent type and untrusted input, tool use or possible side effect is true
rules.effect: Select bounded tool-boundary and threat-model work; model output and external content are not authority.

rules.name: Bounded-write agent needs per-action controls
rules.predicate: Write-capable tool or side effect is true
rules.effect: Select authorization/approval design; absent accountable approver makes write path INCOMPLETE and unauthorized.

rules.name: No write capability means no write-approval obligation
rules.predicate: Write tool and side effects are explicitly false
rules.effect: Mark high-impact write action INAPPLICABLE; retain only read-scoped allowlisted tool design.

rules.name: Network API boundary follows explicit API scope
rules.predicate: API type and network_api true
rules.effect: Select API boundary design; auth only when explicit auth/user/role facts require it.

rules.name: Authentication follows explicit identity requirements
rules.predicate: authenticated_users, authentication_required and role_based_authorization are false for a public read-only API
rules.effect: Mark authentication feature INAPPLICABLE; do not add auth middleware or account model by default.

rules.name: Tenant isolation follows explicit tenant requirement
rules.predicate: multi_tenant or tenant_isolation_required true
rules.effect: Select tenant-isolation design CONDITIONALLY pending mapping, threat, recovery and isolation evidence; never infer from API/SaaS category.

rules.name: Queue requires operational justification
rules.predicate: Queue requested but load/durability justification or accountable operations owner false/unknown
rules.effect: Do not recommend broker; retain queue as INCOMPLETE/CONDITIONAL and list evidence needed.

rules.name: Network API risk review
rules.predicate: Authenticated or publicly reachable API is in scope
rules.effect: Select scoped threat/risk review; do not equate it to a passed security gate.

rules.name: Offline local-file CLI scope
rules.predicate: CLI type and local_filesystem_input true with offline_only true
rules.effect: Select local input/output/exit contract and non-destructive file tests; reject network/account/tenant/service obligations when explicitly false.

rules.name: CLI conditional dependency, upload and distribution controls
rules.predicate: Dependency, network upload or distribution fact is requested or unknown
rules.effect: Keep packaging/upload conditional until target, authorization, data scope and dependencies are known; never add service deployment solely from distribution.

rules.name: Core lifecycle plan
rules.predicate: Category is calibrated and facts are not contradictory
rules.effect: Select applicable discovery, requirements/risk, architecture, implementation and verification stages; add release planning only when explicitly required.

rules.name: Release planning is not release authorization
rules.predicate: Release plan explicitly required
rules.effect: Select release planning only; release readiness remains INCOMPLETE without candidate-bound execution evidence and approval.

rules.name: Use category as scope, not feature inference
rules.predicate: Requested type is calibrated and each emitted record has an active typed applicability edge
rules.effect: Select type overview as scoped context; do not infer database, tenancy, cloud, Kubernetes, billing or vector search.

rules.name: Architecture patterns are options bounded by facts
rules.predicate: An architecture record is applicable through an active typed edge and all explicit exclusions are respected
rules.effect: Select only applicable architecture options; include trade-offs and missing design inputs; no mandatory unrequested component.

rules.name: Core practice scope
rules.predicate: Practice is applicable to type and supports a stated requirement or baseline quality obligation
rules.effect: Select requirements traceability/change review only within its applicability and mark unresolved candidate-specific work incomplete.

rules.name: Verification plan is not execution
rules.predicate: A test strategy is applicable
rules.effect: Select test plan and evidence needs; never claim a run or a pass without linked candidate-specific execution evidence.

rules.name: Dependency-aware roadmap
rules.predicate: A calibrated project needs staged work
rules.effect: Use risk-first ordering for material agent/tool uncertainty; otherwise smallest increment plus dependency-aware sequence. Preserve typed task dependencies; do not invent calendar estimates.

rules.name: Prompt contract is scoped and evidence-aware
rules.predicate: A prompt record is applicable to a selected task
rules.effect: Use scoped implementation/test/review contracts; prompts cannot authorize side effects or claim tests passed.

rules.name: Reference project is a scoped example
rules.predicate: A pinned example exists for the calibrated type and example use is requested
rules.effect: Select as contextual evidence only; pin commit, paths and source locators; do not treat test files or CI configuration as execution.

rules.name: Applicability mismatch abstains
rules.predicate: No active typed edge supports requested category-to-record or record-to-source path
rules.effect: Reject the claim as INAPPLICABLE/INCOMPLETE; never substitute a broad category label for evidence.

priority_semantics: Highest-priority applicable safety/abstention rule dominates positive rules. Explicit false excludes; unknown is not false and produces a pending condition.
